messages.author: 0f89b14b3fb60e4b
messages.subject: Using "extras" with DataTables
parts:
I am very pleased with the integration of DataTables with the latest version of Shiny. Although I knew nothing about them before yesterday, I am happy with the new output type.

I converted some of my tables to DataTables in my Shiny app, and there were some tweaks that I wanted to make after reading some of the examples at www.datatables.net. However, I am not exactly sure how to enable some of the options, and whether or not some of the "extras" of DataTables are integrated with Shiny.

For example, I have a very wide table where I want to fix the first column to remain on the left. I found some documentation from DataTables to implement this in javascript, but I am not sure how to implement it through Shiny. See example here: http://datatables.net/extras/fixedcolumns/

Is it possible to use the "Fixed Columns" feature of DataTables through Shiny? If yes, how would I code this?

Thanks,

Jonathan

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Using "extras" with DataTables
parts:
Currently, Shiny's DataTables don't support passing javascript directly since everything is converted into JSON. 

Future versions might relax that constraint.
